Test_Description: Verify default reset values and write-read operations for all GPIO registers (gp0_gpio_8 to gp0_gpio_30). The test checks reset values after power-on and then writes multiple patterns (0xFFFFFFFF 0xAAAAAAAA 0x55555555 0xF5F5F5F5 0xA5A5A5A5 0xFFFF0000) and reads back to verify correctness using read/write masks.
Test_Procedure:
1. Apply reset (hreset_n active low).
2. Read all GPIO registers and compare against default reset values.
3. Write pattern 0xFFFFFFFF to all writable registers using write_mask.
4. Read back and verify against expected value (considering read_mask and write_mask).
5. Repeat steps 3-4 for patterns: 0xAAAAAAAA 0x55555555 0xF5F5F5F5 0xA5A5A5A5 0xFFFF0000.
6. Check def_fail_cnt and wr_fail_cnt are 0 for PASS.
Expected_Result: All GPIO register default values match expected reset values. All write-read patterns match expected values after masking. Test finishes with exit code 0 (PASS).
Register_Description: Determines the level gpio pin. Read returns the current value of the corresponding pin regardless of whether the pin is an input or an output
Remarks: Covers registers gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_30. VRRW registers are skipped in write test.

Test_Description: Verify GPIO level-select interrupt enable for active HIGH level. For each GPIO pin (8-39) configure input mode with level interrupt enabled (bit 20=1 bit 19=1) and verify interrupt is generated when pin level matches selected level.
Test_Procedure:
1. Enable GIC IRQ 87 (GPIO0) or 88 (GPIO1).
2. Enable sysreg interrupt for GPIO0/GPIO1.
3. For each GPIO pin i (0 to 31):
   a. Write 0x00180000 to gp0_gpio_8+(i*4) to set input mode and level_sel=1.
   b. Enable group interrupt: write (1<<i) to gp0_intr1_intr_en1 (0x84).
   c. Write 0xFFFFFFFF to SRAM trigger location.
   d. Wait for interrupt (int_pend goes to 0 in ISR).
4. In ISR: verify intr_raw_sts bit is set verify group interrupt status clear interrupt and verify clearance.
Expected_Result: Interrupt is generated for each GPIO pin when level matches selected level (HIGH). ISR confirms: raw interrupt status bit set group interrupt status bit set. After clearing: raw status cleared group status cleared sysreg status cleared. test_err = 0.
Register_Description: GPIO Pin signal level on which interrupt should be generated. 0-generate interrupt on level 0; 1-generate interrupt on level 1
Remarks: Tests active HIGH level interrupt for all 32 GPIO pins

Test_Description: Verify GPIO level-select interrupt enable for active LOW level. For each GPIO pin (8-39) configure input mode with level interrupt enabled (bit 20=1 bit 19=0) and verify interrupt is generated when pin level is LOW.
Test_Procedure:
1. For each GPIO pin i (0 to 31):
   a. Write 0x00100000 to gp0_gpio_8+(i*4) to set input mode and level_sel=0.
   b. Enable group interrupt: write (1<<i) to gp0_intr1_intr_en1 (0x84).
   c. Write ~(1<<i) to SRAM trigger location (force low on target pin).
   d. Wait for interrupt.
4. In ISR: verify intr_raw_sts bit is set verify group interrupt status clear interrupt and verify clearance.
Expected_Result: Interrupt is generated for each GPIO pin when level matches selected level (LOW). ISR confirms: raw interrupt status bit set group interrupt status bit set. After clearing: raw status cleared group status cleared sysreg status cleared. test_err = 0.
Register_Description: GPIO Pin signal level on which interrupt should be generated. 0-generate interrupt on level 0; 1-generate interrupt on level 1
Remarks: Tests active LOW level interrupt for all 32 GPIO pins

Test_Description: Verify GPIO group interrupt enable/status register (gp0_intr1_intr_en1 at 0x84 and gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 at 0x88). Each bit corresponds to one GPIO pin (8-39). Enabling a bit allows that GPIO's interrupt to propagate to the group interrupt output.
Test_Procedure:
1. Write (1<<i) to gp0_intr1_intr_en1 to enable interrupt for GPIO pin i.
2. Trigger interrupt condition on GPIO pin i.
3. Read gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 and verify bit i is set.
4. Clear interrupt and disable group enable.
5. Verify gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 reads 0.
Expected_Result: Group interrupt status bit is set when individual GPIO interrupt fires and group enable is active. Status clears after interrupt clear and group disable.
Register_Field_Name: G8_intr_en to G39_intr_en / G8_intr_sts to G39_intr_sts
Register_Description: Group interrupt enable and masked status for GPIO_8 through GPIO_39

Test_Description: Verify GPIO interrupt clear mechanism using intr_clr field (bit 16 WO) of per-pin GPIO register. Writing 1 to intr_clr should clear the interrupt raw status.
Test_Procedure:
1. Trigger interrupt on GPIO pin.
2. Verify intr_raw_sts (bit 1) is set.
3. Write 0x00110000 to gp0_gpio_8+(i*4) to set intr_clr=1.
4. Wait 20 cycles.
5. Read back register and verify intr_raw_sts is cleared (expected read value 0x100001).
Expected_Result: After writing 1 to intr_clr the interrupt raw status bit is cleared. Register reads back 0x100001 confirming interrupt cleared and io_ctrl still in input mode.
Register_Description: Writing 1 clears the interrupt raw status. Writing 0 No change.

Test_Description: Verify sysreg-level interrupt propagation for GPIO. GPIO0 interrupt maps to sysreg raw_stcr1 bit 1 (gpio0_intr). GPIO1 interrupt maps to sysreg raw_stcr1 bit 2 (gpio1_intr).
Test_Procedure:
1. Enable sysreg interrupt for GPIO0 or GPIO1 via MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1.
2. Trigger GPIO interrupt.
3. In ISR: write to MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 to clear sysreg status.
4. Read back MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 and verify GPIO interrupt bit is cleared.
Expected_Result: Sysreg raw_stcr1 GPIO interrupt bit is set when GPIO interrupt fires. After writing clear bit the sysreg status is cleared.
Register_Description: Sysreg interrupt raw status and clear for GPIO0/GPIO1

Test_Description: Verify GPIO io_ctrl field (bit 20 RW2) for input mode configuration. Setting io_ctrl=1 puts GPIO in input mode which is prerequisite for level-select interrupt testing.
Test_Procedure:
1. Write 0x00180000 or 0x00100000 to gp0_gpio_8+(i*4).
2. Verify bit 20 (io_ctrl) is set to 1 (input mode).
3. Verify GPIO can receive external signal level for interrupt generation.
Expected_Result: GPIO is configured in input mode (io_ctrl=1). External signal level is correctly sampled for interrupt generation.
Register_Description: GPIO mode select: 0-Set GPIO in output mode; 1-Set GPIO in input mode
